title: @intentsolutions/core authoring schema index v2 (STRICT profile)
description: Catalog of the STRICT v2 authoring-contract schemas — the strict IS-marketplace contract that closes the 4 CCP-shadow frontmatter gaps. v2 is a fresh, self-contained sibling of authoring/v1 with ZERO $ref into v1 (copy-then-tighten); v1 is BYTE-FROZEN at @intentsolutions/core@0.4.1. ONLY skill-frontmatter is forked to v2 — the other 5 contracts (plugin-manifest, agent-definition, mcp-config, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) stay at v1/SHIPPED-INTERNAL untouched and gain a v2 sibling only if/when one needs a tightening (per-contract, behind CFO sign-off; DR-049 D-SAK-1). The v2 marketplace-tier foundation carries the THREE universal folds with two security tightenings (shell-substitution-widen + reserved-name-substring-hardening) + one disclosure tightening (description cap 1024). skill-frontmatter v2 additionally narrows allowed-tools (scoped-Bash). Source of truth: DR-049 + the CCP kernel-shadow finding.
